# axm skills

Manage agent skill extensions.

## When to use

Use this command family when creating, installing, publishing, or reconciling skills.

## Usage

```bash
axm skills <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](global-flags).

## Examples

**Add a code review skill to your agents**

```bash
axm skills install @acme/skills/code-review
```

**Pin to a specific version range**

```bash
axm skills install @acme/skills/code-review@^1.0.0
```

**Install from a GitHub repository**

```bash
axm skills install owner/repo
```

**See what skills are installed**

```bash
axm skills list
```

**Bump a skill version**

```bash
axm skills version @acme/skills/code-review patch
```

## Subcommands

| Command                                  | Summary                                                                                                  |
| ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [axm skills install](skills/install)     | Reinstall configured skills from their sources, or install skills from a registry, GitHub, or local path |
| [axm skills uninstall](skills/uninstall) | Uninstall a skill from agents                                                                            |
| [axm skills list](skills/list)           | List installed skills                                                                                    |
| [axm skills update](skills/update)       | Update installed skills to latest versions                                                               |
| [axm skills new](skills/new)             | Create a new skill                                                                                       |
| [axm skills enable](skills/enable)       | Enable a previously disabled skill                                                                       |
| [axm skills disable](skills/disable)     | Disable a skill without uninstalling it                                                                  |
| [axm skills version](skills/version)     | Bump a managed skill manifest version                                                                    |
| [axm skills publish](skills/publish)     | Publish extensions to a registry                                                                         |
| [axm skills prune](skills/prune)         | Remove unmanaged skill artifacts from the workspace                                                      |

## Requirements

- workspace

## Side effects

None.
